set.good: I borrowed a book from the library.
bad: I borrow a book from the library yesterday.
I borrowed a book to the library.
I borrowing a book from the library.

cz.st: I ___ a book from the library.

set.rule: borrow는 '(남에게서) 빌려 오다', lend는 '(남에게) 빌려 주다'예요. from the library와 함께 쓰려면 빌려 오는 borrowed가 맞아요.
